about: Questions an agent asks with its steps written in a run, "(1) … (2) …", and what both apps must make of them: runInList and askBlocks in desktop/ui/common.js and in mobile/src/ui/md.ts, each tested against this file. run null: no list. blocks null: the question is shown as it always was.

runs.name: the steps of a setup, what leads in and the question they lead up to
runs.text: This part is yours by hand before I can send the order emails (about 5 minutes, no card needed), with the shop's Postmark account. (1) postmarkapp.com: 'Servers', then 'Create server', any name, Create. (2) On its 'API Tokens' tab click 'Generate token' and copy it (it is shown only once). (3) Under 'Sender Signatures' add orders@storefront.test, then confirm the email it sends you. Do not paste the token into chat. Where are you?

run.before: This part is yours by hand before I can send the order emails (about 5 minutes, no card needed), with the shop's Postmark account.
